newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian rulers start 1997 budget session.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian rulers start 1997 budget session.

text.p: Nigeria's cabinet began meeting on Tuesday in the capital Abuja to consider this year's fiscal budget, presidency officials said.
They said the cabinet session will be followed on Thursday by a meeting of the all-military Provisional Ruling Council, which has the power to approve or reject the budget proposals.
According to Finance Minister Anthony Ani, the 1997 budget will switch emphasis from restoring economic stability to targeting growth and privatisating state-run companies.

Ani told reporters in Abuja on Monday that measures would be contained in the budget to ease the hardship of ordinary Nigerians who had borne the brunt of the military government's belt-tightening policies.
He said military ruler General Sani Abacha was likely to broadcast the budget speech on Friday.
